raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: Misapplied density concepts by using the material density of keratin for feathers (ignoring the extremely low bulk density of loose feathers) and an implausibly low bulk density for iron nails. This reversed the correct comparison. For equal volumes, bulk-packed iron nails (high effective density despite voids) have much greater mass than feathers, so the correct answer is that the mass of the feathers is less than the mass of the nails.
